complete_object.identity_scope: Monic projection identities hold relative to the factored residual ideals. Horn maps preserve the listed exposed coordinates and reconstruct private witnesses in each direction; the maps need not be inverse on old private witnesses.
complete_object.projection_free_coordinates: Use every actual unconstrained_removed coordinate, without assuming its cardinality. Initialize it to zero for the factored chart, then apply the reverse Horn overwrite rules for an old-source witness.

complete_object.witness_transfer: Reconstruct fresh complete Pell/cap/guard witnesses at the unchanged semantic front. No pointwise old full-body or old selected-Pell identity is claimed.

complete_object.search_scope: Eight coordinate-descent passes over non-guard coordinates, local increments ±1,±2,±3,±4,±8; no global optimality claim.
